title: Antigua and Barbuda Drought Hazard Assessment and Mapping: Summary Report
organization: Organization of American States / USAID Caribbean Disaster Mitigation Project
temporal_coverage: Historical drought impacts and watershed conditions assessed in a 2001 technical summary.
methodology: OAS hazard-mapping summary draws on secondary records, maps, consultations and limited field observations.
limitations: The report is dated; rainfall and watershed data were limited, and it does not attribute drought impacts to anthropogenic climate change.

title: Antigua and Barbuda Inland Flood Hazard Mapping: Summary Report
organization: Organization of American States / USAID Caribbean Disaster Mitigation Project
temporal_coverage: Historical flood susceptibility and settlement conditions summarized in 2001.
methodology: OAS technical summary maps inland flood hazards and describes watershed, soil, drainage and settlement factors.
limitations: The maps were preliminary because rainfall, watershed and drainage data were limited; findings are not a current risk assessment.

title: Antigua and Barbuda: Rapid Needs Assessment following Hurricane Irma
organization: Government of Antigua and Barbuda, with World Bank/GFDRR, United Nations and European Union
temporal_coverage: Post-disaster damage, loss and recovery needs after Hurricanes Irma and Maria in September 2017.
methodology: Joint government-partner recovery needs assessment; this source is its executive summary.
limitations: Assessment records disaster impacts and recommended needs, not subsequent completion of recovery measures.

title: Concluding observations on the combined fourth to seventh periodic reports of Antigua and Barbuda
organization: United Nations Committee on the Elimination of Discrimination against Women
temporal_coverage: Committee observations following its 20 February 2019 review; includes consequences of Hurricane Irma and recovery concerns.
methodology: Treaty-body concluding observations based on the State review and information considered by the Committee.
limitations: The observations identify concerns and recommendations; they are not a quantitative assessment of all affected women or recovery outcomes.

title: Capacity Building for Improved Transparency of Climate Change Mitigation and Adaptation in Antigua and Barbuda: Terminal Review
organization: United Nations Environment Programme / Global Environment Facility
temporal_coverage: Terminal evaluation of the 2019–2024 CBIT project, with primary review work in October–November 2025.
methodology: Full terminal review assesses project outputs, outcomes, performance and sustainability using document review and stakeholder evidence.
limitations: This evaluates climate-data and reporting institutions, not household adaptation outcomes; sustainability ratings are evaluative judgments.

title: National Adaptation Plan: Sectoral Adaptation Plans and Local Area Adaptation Plans
organization: Department of Environment, Government of Antigua and Barbuda
temporal_coverage: Government announcement on 8 July 2026 of national, sectoral and local adaptation plans.
methodology: Department of Environment webpage summarizes the NAP, sectoral plans and named local planning areas.
limitations: The announcement describes plans and participation, not implementation, financing or measured resilience outcomes.
